observed_result: internal/redact passes its five tests. TestLineMasksSecrets: "sk-" plus 8+ [A-Za-z0-9_-] becomes "sk-[redacted]" (sk-abcdefgh12345678; sk-short stays unmasked), "Bearer <token>" becomes "Bearer [redacted]" (Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOi.xx), token= / api_key= / apikey= (case-insensitive key) followed by a non-space, non-&, non-" run becomes "<key>=[redacted]" (GET /x?token=abc123&y=1, API_KEY=Q1w2E3), JSON string members token/api_key/secret/password have their value replaced by "[redacted]" ({"api_key":"abc",...}, {"password":"p\"q"}). TestLineHashesRawPayloads: raw_text/audio/image string members keep only "[len=N sha256=XXXXXXXX]" with N the decoded byte length and XXXXXXXX the first 8 lowercase hex of the value's SHA-256 ("hello" -> [len=5 sha256=2cf24dba], "" -> [len=0 sha256=e3b0c442]). TestLineLeavesCleanLinesUntouched: clean lines (plain logs, {"raw_text": null}, {"token_reference": "sk-abc", ...}) come back byte-for-byte unchanged. TestWriterMasksAcrossWriteBoundaries: a secret split across Write calls is still masked on the forwarded line, a partial trailing line is held and only emitted at Flush, also masked. TestWriterNeverEmitsTheSecret: over 50 random-split iterations the writer never emits the secret and Flush always yields the fully masked line. The root package passes its three privacy tests. TestOnlyNetworkPackagesImportHTTP runs go list -deps over ./... and asserts that only download, teacher and internal/cli import net/http directly; internal/cli is allowed only for the HEAD check of the `data sources` audit (internal/cli/data.go imports net/http), a pre-existing deviation recorded here, same as the allow-list comment in privacy_test.go. TestNoTelemetry walks every non-test Go file and finds no analytics/telemetry/segment.io/sentry/mixpanel/posthog string at all. TestScanCommitScriptFlagsSecrets drives scripts/scan-commit.sh against throwaway git repositories: secret-in-added-line (staged sk-abcdefgh12345678) exits 1 and prints the file with rule=secret, clean-staged-diff exits 0 and prints PASS, oversized-file (a staged 6 MiB file) exits 1 and prints rule=size. scripts/scan-commit.sh implements four rules on the staged diff: (1) secret on added lines with sk-^/Bearer-style or api_key/apikey/token/secret/password key/value shapes, (2) size for added or modified staged files over 5 MiB, (3) data for added files under data/raw/, data/malecns/ or any other data/** file that is not .md or .json, (4) teacher_response appearing together with an "answer" field in an added line; exit status is 0 (prints 'PASS' and 'staged diff is clean'), 1 (one line per finding file:line: rule=..., 'commit blocked'), or 2 (usage error or not a git repository); the script is read-only and never writes a file, touches the working tree or modifies the index. .githooks/pre-commit just execs scripts/scan-commit.sh and is not installed automatically.
